⚡ Welcome to Electrical Design & Simulation! ⚡
This channel is dedicated to Electrical Engineering, Electrical Design, and Simulation. 🔧💻
Here you will find easy-to-understand tutorials and practical guides on software such as MATLAB/Simulink, ETAP, AutoCAD Electrical, Proteus, PSCAD, and other useful Electrical Engineering tools.
📚 What You’ll Learn: 🔹 Electrical circuit design & simulation
🔹 Power system analysis
🔹 MATLAB & Simulink tutorials
🔹 ETAP projects and simulations
🔹 AutoCAD Electrical design
🔹 Proteus circuit simulation
🔹 Electrical engineering projects
🔹 Practical tips and engineering concepts
🎯 Our Goal: To make Electrical Engineering software and simulation simple, practical, and easy for students and engineers.
🔔 Subscribe to Electrical Design & Simulation and learn, design, simulate, and grow with us! ⚡💡
